2026-08-22.title: 8月21日CPO概念股走强：半年报兑现叠加光互连技术进展
2026-08-22.facts: 8月21日CPO概念股走强。报道将行情归因于半年报业绩集中兑现与技术突破预期的双重共振：深科达上半年净利润同比增长198.23%，生益电子增长109.36%，东田微增长71.57%，星网锐捷增长75.9%。同期发表的CPO论文梳理了从2D共封装、2.5D中介层到3D异质堆叠的技术路径，并指出热管理、可制造性和标准化仍是落地障碍；光互连的目标是缓解AI系统中处理器与存储器之间的带宽、时延和能耗约束。

2026-08-22.title: 8月21日A股收评：创业板领涨，贵金属、锂矿与通信设备走强

2026-08-22.title: Wall Street rises as business activity, miners and crypto-linked stocks offset higher yields
2026-08-22.facts: U.S. stocks closed higher on August 21: the S&P 500 rose 0.4%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 1.0%, and the Nasdaq composite added 0.4%. S&P Global's preliminary business-activity reading reached a 52-month high. Ross Stores rose 4.4% after stronger profit and revenue, while Newmont gained 3.1% and Freeport-McMoRan rose 7.6%; bitcoin-related shares also advanced. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.73% from 4.69%, acting as a counterweight to equities.
